# TikTok Scraper

The Apify actor [`apidojo/tiktok-scraper`](https://apify.com/apidojo/tiktok-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its default build **0.0.1182** (module version **0.3.0**). Runs use whatever build the actor has as default when they start, so they keep working as Apify retires old builds; the input types below are refreshed weekly and can lag an actor that changed its input since.

TikTok scraper for videos, profiles, hashtags, music and locations at $0.30 per 1,000 posts. Extract captions, views, likes, comment counts, shares and creator details from TikTok URLs, usernames, hashtags or keywords. No login needed.

## Pricing

Pay per event — post $0.0003 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apidojo/tiktok-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apidojo-tiktok-scraper@0.3.0#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Telo.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hashtags` | array \| null |  | `null` | Videos with this hashtag — Hashtags to scrape videos from. The leading # is optional. |
| `resultsPerPage` | integer \| null |  | `null` | Number of videos per hashtag, profile or search — Optional. Maximum number of items to scrape per source (hashtag, profile, search query, URL). Leave empty for no per-source limit. Maximum number of items in total still caps the whole run. |
| `profiles` | array \| null |  | `null` | Usernames — TikTok usernames (with or without @) or numeric user IDs to scrape videos from. |
| `profileSorting` | string \| null |  |  | Profile video sorting — Order of posts scraped from profiles (profile URLs and profiles). Leave empty to use the default order (latest). |
